meta.name: migrate-slack-agents
meta.description: Migrate a classic single-bot Slack install to one provisioned Slack app per existing agent group while preserving agent identities, workspaces, memory, and wiring behavior — or record the operator's choice to stay on classic, which remains supported. Use when /update-nanoclaw surfaces the Slack agents requirement, or standalone any time later.

copy.tagline: 迁移 Slack 机器人架构为每组独立应用，保留身份与记忆
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在使用经典 Slack 机器人并需按 agent 分组独立应用
copy.tagline_en: Migrate classic Slack bots to per-agent apps, preserving identities and memory
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run a classic Slack bot setup and need per-agent Slack apps

howto.what: 该技能把现有单个 Slack 机器人的代理环境，迁移为每个代理组各自配一个独立 Slack 应用的模式，过程中保留代理身份、工作区、记忆和原有连线行为；迁移由操作者引导，可暂停恢复。若操作者选择维持经典模式，它只记录该决定，不改动现有设置。
howto.when: 当 /update-nanoclaw 提示需要 Slack 代理时，或之后任意时间手动单独运行此技能时触发。

say.text: 运行 /migrate-slack-agents，我选择保留经典单机器人模式。
say.note: 它会记录决定，不改变现有 Slack 配置。

howto.what_en: Converts a single-bot Slack install to one Slack app per agent group, keeping identities, workspaces, memory, and wiring. Operator-driven and resumable. If the operator opts to stay classic, only that choice is recorded.
howto.when_en: Trigger when /update-nanoclaw surfaces a Slack agents requirement, or any later time when run standalone.

say_en.text: Run /migrate-slack-agents to give each agent group its own Slack bot.
say_en.note: It checks current state, asks you to confirm the plan, then migrates.

say_en.text: Run /migrate-slack-agents and choose to keep the classic single bot.
say_en.note: It records your choice and leaves existing Slack config untouched.
